requirements_deferred_with_reason: REQ-012 (versioned sourced job/composite formulas): requires EP-007 content hardening and sourced policy data; no formula table exists yet. NOT claimed.
REQ-013 (retest planner versioned policy data): depends on REQ-012 policy data. NOT claimed.

REQ-024 (Gemini Notebook manual export / enterprise connector): the manual notebook export capability is declared offline-available (REQ-042), but the enterprise connector is an optional licensed integration not built in this node. NOT claimed.

REQ-016/017/018 (native provider lanes): the POLICY and ROUTING contract is implemented and tested, but no native client process is actually invoked, because that requires real provider logins which do not exist in this environment (PREFLIGHT PF-007/008/009). The contract is real; live provider invocation is an external gate.

stub_check.note: No placeholder or constant-return production paths added. FSRS computes real scheduling arithmetic; the planner derives priority from real inputs; the transport router enforces real policy gates; MCP authorizes real capability grants.

thin_test_check.note: 83 tests across six new suites. Coverage includes boundary conditions, negative behavior, property tests over an input grid, deterministic reproducibility, and security properties rather than happy paths.

evidence_sticker_check.note: Evidence is real command output with exit codes and SHA-256 hashes. Mutation proofs record which mutations were DETECTED and, equally importantly, which one initially SURVIVED and why.

test_weakening_check.note: No assertion was deleted, skipped, or loosened for a green run. Every test correction made the test strictly stronger.

real_defects_found_and_fixed: MCP path traversal: '/data/drafts/../../../etc/passwd' was ACCEPTED because normalization preserved '..' while still performing prefix containment. Now any residual '..' segment is refused outright.

MCP section forging: untrusted content containing a literal '[INSTRUCTIONS]' produced a second, attacker-controlled instruction block because neutralization handled only code fences. Structural markers are now defanged inside data blocks.
Guard with an untested error path: the offline core-violation branch was unreachable from the public API. The rule was extracted into classify_offline() and is now directly tested.

Pre-existing blocker fixed: every Tauri icon was a 70-byte PNG placeholder under an .ico/.icns extension, which made 'cargo test --workspace' fail outright. Real multi-resolution assets are now generated by scripts/generate-icons.py.

validator_defect_found_and_fixed.defect: The placeholder-residue check flagged any file containing the substring '{{' or '}}'. Valid nested JSON necessarily contains '}}' wherever an object closes inside another object, so apps/desktop/src-tauri/gen/schemas/acl-manifests.json (valid JSON, 335 occurrences) was reported as placeholder residue and preflight FAILED.
validator_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: The check now matches actual placeholder shapes (double-brace identifiers, shell-style parameter expansion, angle-bracket tokens) and skips files that parse as valid JSON.
validator_defect_found_and_fixed.is_this_gate_weakening: NO. The check was made more precise, not weaker, and this was PROVEN rather than asserted: .agent/evidence/EP-004/placeholder-check-proof.py plants genuine placeholder residue of each shape in a disposable pack and confirms the validator still FAILS on every one, while valid nested JSON now PASSES. 6/6 cases behaved as required (exit 0).

known_limitations: Native provider lanes (Grok/Codex/Claude) are policy-modelled and routing-tested but not live-invoked: no provider logins exist in this environment (PREFLIGHT PF-007..PF-009). This is an external gate, not a completed integration.

Local llama.cpp GGUF inference (REQ-014) is classified as an offline-available core capability and the transport is registered, but no model process is launched in this node; PREFLIGHT PF-010 remains an external capability probe.
MCP is modelled as an in-process capability/authorization registry. No loopback listener is bound in this node; the transport binding belongs to the desktop shell work in EP-005.
The FSRS weights are the published FSRS-4.5 defaults. Per-learner parameter optimisation from review history is not implemented and is not claimed.
